milestone.title: raul keybind overhaul v1: Action enum + Keybinds from project config + combo parser

intent.outcome: raul's key handling is driven by a Keybinds config loaded from master-plan/config.json (via mp config show), with a human-friendly combo parser (ctrl+shift+up, esc, f1..f12, named symbols) and an Action enum (replacing the current Event enum). The 39-line event.rs file becomes a typed, testable, configurable system. Help overlay and footer text are generated from the same struct — single source of truth. Adding a new shortcut is a one-place change in the Keybinds default, not a four-file edit.

problem.description: crates/raul/src/tui/event.rs is a 39-line file with a flat Event enum and a hand-rolled map_key_event() that hardcodes every binding: KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Char('Q') if key.modifiers.is_empty() => Some(Event::Quit), etc. The 'is_empty()' guard is repeated for every letter key (lines 23, 29-36) to disambiguate A (create annotation) from a (something else). Adding a new shortcut means: add an Event variant, add a match arm in map_key_event, update the help overlay text, update the footer text. Four places, easy to miss one. Worse: bindings are not user-configurable — if a user wants j/k swapped to n/p (Neovim style), they fork raul. herdr's src/config/keybinds.rs solves this with: (1) ActionKeybinds struct keyed by action (not key), (2) parse_key_combo() that handles ctrl+shift+up, named symbols, f-keys, and auto-applies SHIFT for uppercase (no more 'q' | 'Q' is_empty dance), (3) Vec<ResolvedBinding> per action so one action can have multiple keys, (4) config-loaded with diagnostics. raul already loads UI prefs from ProjectConfig (crates/raul/src/config.rs:46-73) so the new keybinds hang off the same plumbing, not a new file.

in_scope: Remove the Event enum from crates/raul/src/tui/event.rs. M136 owns the tui::Action enum (crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs); M138 does NOT redefine it — it adds the keybind-resolution layer (Keybinds::resolve(KeyEvent) -> Option<Action>) that produces M136 Actions. If M138 lands before M136, M138 creates Action in tui/action.rs per the M136 contract so the two share one home and do not diverge.

New module crates/raul/src/tui/key_combo.rs with KeyCombo type, parse_key_combo(&str) -> Option<KeyCombo> handling ctrl/alt/shift/super/meta modifiers, named keys (enter, esc, tab, backspace, space), function keys (f1..f12), named symbols (minus, comma, period, slash, ampersand, etc.), case-insensitive input, auto-applies SHIFT for uppercase letters (so 'Q' parses to shift+q)

New module crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs with Keybinds struct (one field per Action), Default impl with raul's current hardcoded bindings, resolve(key_event) -> Option<Action> doing the inverse lookup, load_from_config(json) loading from [keybinds] section

Add Keybinds struct to crates/mp/src/config.rs ProjectConfig (Keybinds { quit: BindingConfig, up: BindingConfig, ... } — one field per Action variant from M136). The Action enum itself is NOT redefined here; M136 owns it. NOTE: this [keybinds] ProjectConfig schema addition is the shared prerequisite for M140 (Settings TUI reads/writes the same section); coordinate the mp-side config.rs edit if M140 is in flight.
Extend existing mp config show | get | set plumbing to handle the [keybinds] section (no CLI changes — the existing key=value interface should already work, just need to verify and add tests)
Wire raul to load Keybinds from mp config show (same pattern as UiConfig::load in crates/raul/src/config.rs:46-73) and pass to dispatch
Refactor crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs to use Keybinds::resolve(key) -> Option<Action> at the top of the dispatch (replacing the inline map_key_event call)
Refactor help overlay and footer text generation in render.rs to read from Keybinds struct (single source of truth — no separate hand-edited help/footer strings)

Test fixtures: lift herdr's parse_key_combo test cases (keybinds.rs:1443+ in herdr/src) — at least 20 cases: 'v', 'ö', 'alt+é', 'shift+tab', 'minus', 'comma', 'ampersand', 'f12', 'ctrl+shift+up', etc.

Tests: parse_key_combo is_total (every test case round-trips); Keybinds::resolve returns the right action for every default binding; Keybinds::load_from_config handles missing/malformed entries without crashing (fall back to defaults)
out_of_scope: User-level config override (~/.config/raul/keybinds.toml) — v2 or later; v1 is project-level only, matching the current [ui] pattern
Prefix mode (herdr's ctrl+b style) — not justified for raul today
Indexed bindings (1-9 N-th item) — v2 if needed
Custom commands (user-defined key → shell command) — out of scope for v1/v2

acceptance_criteria.description: M136 Action (crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs) is the sole key-dispatch enum. The empty event.rs marker is removed; any leftover local Event key-dispatch types are migrated to Action. M138 does not redefine Action — it only cleans leftovers and adds Keybinds::resolve → Action.

steps.action: Delete the empty crates/raul/src/tui/event.rs marker (M136 already owns Action in tui/action.rs). Grep for any remaining tui::Event / local Event key-dispatch enums (e.g. modes/normal.rs) and migrate them to Action. Confirm KeyEvent dispatch produces Action only — do NOT redefine Action.
steps.done_when: event.rs gone or re-exported away; no tui Event key-dispatch type remains; Action is the sole key-dispatch enum

steps.action: Create crates/raul/src/tui/key_combo.rs. Define KeyCombo = (KeyCode, KeyModifiers). Implement parse_key_combo(s: &str) -> Option<KeyCombo> handling ctrl/alt/shift/super/meta modifiers, named keys (enter, esc, tab, backspace, space), function keys (f1..f12), named symbols (minus, comma, period, slash, ampersand, etc.), case-insensitive input, and auto-applies SHIFT for uppercase letters.
steps.done_when: parse_key_combo compiles; test fixtures from herdr keybinds.rs:1443+ (at least 20 cases) pass.

steps.action: Create crates/raul/src/tui/keybinds.rs with Keybinds struct (one field per Action, each holding a Vec<KeyCombo> or a BindingConfig). Implement Default with raul's current hardcoded bindings. Implement resolve(key_event) -> Option<Action> doing the inverse lookup. Implement load_from_config(json) that reads [keybinds] from the ProjectConfig JSON and falls back to Default on missing or malformed entries (with a tracing warn).
steps.done_when: Keybinds compiles; Default matches current raul behavior; load_from_config returns Keybinds for both valid and missing sections.

steps.action: Add Keybinds struct to crates/mp/src/config.rs ProjectConfig (alongside UiConfig). Add the [keybinds] section to the default config templates (templates/defaults/config.full.json and config.hybrid.json). Verify `mp config set keybinds.<action> <combo>` works via the existing config_cmd.rs path.
steps.done_when: Keybinds field on ProjectConfig; mp config show includes [keybinds]; mp config set round-trips.

steps.action: In crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs, replace the inline map_key_event() call with Keybinds::resolve(key_event) -> Option<Action>. Load Keybinds from mp config show at the top of the TUI run, the same way UiConfig is loaded in config.rs:46-73. Pass the resolved Keybinds into the dispatch path.
steps.done_when: No more inline map_key_event; Keybinds::resolve drives the dispatch; TUI honors the [keybinds] config section.

steps.action: Generate help overlay (?) and footer text by iterating the Keybinds struct in the render/ modules (chrome/overlays — post-split paths under crates/raul/src/tui/render/). Remove hardcoded key lists. Single source of truth with Keybinds.
steps.done_when: Help overlay lists every default-bound action with formatted key display; footer text reflects actual bindings; no hand-edited key lists remain.

findings.description: Co-approval overlay legend was hardcoded '[A]pprove  [R]eject' but the dispatcher maps ToggleApproval→Approve (bound to 'p') and ReopenAnnotation→Reject (bound to 'R'); pressing A did nothing. Fixed: legend + status line now driven from app.keybinds (approve/reopen/enter/escape/quit) so it cannot drift.
